/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '526,565p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && rg -n -A 55 'interface LogoProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(ArrowUpRight|ArrowRight|CircleCheck|Clock|Bell|Ellipsis|CircleQuestion|ChevronDown|ArrowDownToLine|Check)\\.js"'$'"' && npm ls @bem-react/classname @gravity-ui/icons --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-button-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | sort -u && rg -n 'asideHeaderSize|ASIDE_HEADER|size:|expanded' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/density.js | head -25 && git diff --stat && cat vite.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && test -x node_modules/.bin/prettier && node_modules/.bin/prettier --write src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/styles.css index.html'
